about_the_game:
You are the manager of a rising freight company in this strategy-infused management sim. Choose the best cargo deals, plan your routes, and keep your fleet running smoothly — from fueling and repairs to tugboat rentals or sailing your own ships.

Maneuvering

You can save money by steering ships yourself instead of hiring tugboats, but be careful, because ship repairs can be costly. If you damage your ship too much, you might send it into the abyss.

Features

  •  Keep ships fueled, repaired, and ready for the next haul.

  • Rent tugboats or take the helm yourself.

  • Optional sailing in a top-down 2D look with 3D-rendered ships and environments.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel or AMD) @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Quad-core processor (Intel or AMD)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Vulkan support (NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel Arc)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU (Intel/AMD) @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, or DX12-capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core processor (Intel or AMD)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
